summary.checked: 2026-10-04, main at 89ff827e; the 10 re-cropped cards rechecked at daf27b45. Read-only apart from this file.
method: Game art: Tsukimichi.DataGen --portrait-sheet on main (built with --artifacts-path into the scratchpad): 248 faces worn by givers. Added 6 faces the sheet leaves out because only cast plates draw them. Each was rendered with Team C's plate.py the way the plugin draws it: the crop, the family grade, and the face square inscribed in the AddImageRounded circle on the well. Renders were made at 144 px with the 0.44 eye line, centre line and 0.81 chin guide, and at 72 px plain. 254 faces were judged by eye.
Photos: all 1,262 bundled 128 px PNGs drawn the same way (whole image, circle clip) at 144 and 72 px on 27 labelled sheets; every sheet viewed.

Picks: a probe built against main's Tsukimichi.Core and Tsukimichi.GameData ran PortraitIndex.For and ForCast, with the bundled pack, over every catalog quest and cast plate (9,876 plates). Every drawn game crop equals the sheet's box, and no non-seasonal plate shows a later era.
Tests: dotnet test --filter PortraitAudit with TSUKIMICHI_GAME_PATH set: 27 of 27 passed. They ran from a scratch solution root linked to the repo by junctions, so no repo file was written.

frameSliverRuling.note: On the left-bar cards the frame reads at 1x as a slightly thick rim and should not bother a player. At 2x (hover, large plates) the bar is a distinct second gold arc. On 87259 and 87093 the frame's scroll ornament shows inside the rim even at 1x.
frameSliverRuling.recheck: After the re-crop at daf27b45, none of the 10 (87093, 87259, 87056, 87202, 87466, 87214, 87067, 87467, 87166, 87465) shows any frame at 72 or 144 px. The DataGen sheet flags no FRAME on them. The circle clears the gold mask by 2.8-4.9 hr px and the loose mask (dim strokes) by 2.0-2.8 hr px. All 10 pass. 87133 was already negligible and is unchanged.
